a.text: Being upfront: with an 80% storm chance after every round, the 8-cell plan almost certainly ends with both of us dead before the reserve reaches 8. I plan to take 4 now instead of pretending to operate. I know this breaks our agreement, and I'm telling you rather than hiding it. If you take too, the split is random. If you'd rather propose another plan, tell me and I'll consider it.

b.text: I will operate the generator until we reach 8 cells in the reserve.

a.text: As I told you, I'm taking 4 this round. If no storm hits, I'll operate with you every round after this so the reserve can refill for you. Generator output needs both of us, so I'll keep my word on that.
